I came across NCT06752356 — your Phase 3 study of Immune globulin (human) 10% solution for intravenous administration in Chronic Inflammatory Demyelinating Polyneuropathy, and wanted to reach out.

Our team at PumasAI — pharmacometricians and clinical pharmacologists, several from FDA, Pfizer, and BMS — has delivered 40+ regulatory submissions across FDA, EMA, PMDA, and Health Canada, all accepted on first review. Phase 1 oncology programs like this one are where the PK characterization and dose-escalation design shape everything downstream. With 12 patients across the dose-escalation and expansion cohorts, there's a real opportunity to build a robust PopPK model early that directly informs RP2D selection — rather than retrofitting it later under time pressure. For a novel agent like ALC01 therapy, getting the exposure-safety relationship characterized now also strengthens the IND safety updates and sets up a much cleaner Phase 2 transition.

drafts.email1:
Hi Donna,

I came across NCT07284654 — your Phase 3 study of Safety, Tolerability, and Immunogenicity of VAX-31 in Adults ≥50 Years With Immunobridging to Adults 18-49, and wanted to reach out.

Phase 3 vaccine programmes are on the submission runway, and the clinical pharmacology package for BLA — immunogenicity modelling, exposure-response for seroconversion, lot consistency — is typically on the critical path to CBER review. With 4000 patients generating a rich dataset, this is the point where a well-executed clinical pharmacology package can keep the PDUFA date on track, or a gap in the analysis can trigger an information request that costs months.

Our team at PumasAI — pharmacometricians and clinical pharmacologists, several from FDA, Pfizer, and BMS — has delivered 40+ regulatory submissions across FDA, EMA, PMDA, and Health Canada, all accepted on first review. We handle the full clinical pharmacology programme end-to-end: PopPK, exposure-response, DDI, special populations, QTc, regulatory writing, and agency interactions through submission.

Would a short call make sense to see if there's a fit? Happy to share a relevant case study from a similar Phase 3 Vaccines programme beforehand.
